metadata.description: Unique id for the scheduled alert rule

properties.description: Detects curl.exe invoked with Telegram-related URLs or writing output under AppData\Local\Temp, which can indicate payload staging or C2 retrieval via Telegram.
properties.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FolderPath endswith "\\curl.exe" and (ProcessCommandLine contains "api.telegram.org/s/" or ProcessCommandLine contains "telegram.me/s/" or ProcessCommandLine contains "-o" or ProcessCommandLine contains "\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\")
